What if ChatGPT was Gandhiji?
What if instead of asking ChatGPT for advice, you went straight to Bapu? Introducing GandhiJIPT — your very own AI assistant powered by truth, non-violence, and a whole lot of walking.
From helping a gym bro with his diet and a Bollywood writer with his action-packed climax to dealing with relationship drama and people looking to make money overnight, Bapu has a solution for everyone. The only problem? His solutions might not be exactly what you had in mind.
And when Munna Bhai walks in looking for a fresh idea for his next film, Bapu has just one answer for him…
